title: Auto Fuel X
description: auto-fuel-x is a web-based management system for fuel stations and vehicle service centers. It handles vehicle registration, fuel dispensing records, service history, and inventory — all through a role-based admin dashboard. Built with Jakarta EE (Servlets and JSP) on the backend and Microsoft SQL Server for data storage, it was designed as a full enterprise-style web application for a second-year university module.
long-description: Built as a Year 2 Semester 1 university project, auto-fuel-x is a full-stack enterprise-style web application. It manages fuel station operations — vehicle registration, fuel dispensing logs, service records, and inventory — through a clean admin dashboard powered by Jakarta EE (Servlets & JSP) and Microsoft SQL Server.
